label: Workforce
definition: People's working time: duty logs, hours-of-work limits, rest and rolling windows, for any crew, shift or rota.

label: Transport
definition: Legs, dwell, cut-offs and punctuality, shared by road, rail, sea and air.

label: Intermodal
definition: Container free time, demurrage and detention clocks, billing deadlines, bill of lading dates, multimodal journeys, EPCIS events and EDI timestamps.
